messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "clinical guidelines"
set: ["clinical guidelines", "US clinical trial", "up to 3% in clinical trials", "clinical assessment of acute abdominal condition", "clinical trials of immediate-release tablets conducted", "dose increases should be based on clinical response", "more than 1% of patients in clinical trials", "no clinical studies show reduces risk of macrovascular disease", "additional dose increases after several more weeks if insufficient clinical improvement", "may increase dose after several weeks if there is lack of clinical improvement", "median time to meaningful pain relief was 2 to 3 hours in clinical trials", "dose increases after several more weeks if there is a lack of clinical improvement for lower-weight children", "recommended dose", "take prescribed dose as indicated by healthcare provider", "this medication guide", "follow your doctor's instructions"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "US clinical trial",
    "up to 3% in clinical trials",
    "clinical trials of immediate-release tablets conducted",
    "more than 1% of patients in clinical trials",
    "median time to meaningful pain relief was 2 to 3 hours in clinical trials",
    "no clinical studies show reduces risk of macrovascular disease",
    "additional dose increases after several more weeks if insufficient clinical improvement",
    "may increase dose after several weeks if there is lack of clinical improvement",
    "dose increases after several more weeks if there is a lack of clinical improvement for lower-weight children"
  ],
  "alias": "clinical trials"
}
